raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #45953.

GLM non-streaming tool-call parsing can silently drop a defined tool when the captured function name contains surrounding whitespace. A GLM-4.7/5 response such as `<tool_call>get_weather` followed by a newline and its argument tags is rejected as an unknown function; both `tool_calls` and visible content can be empty. GLM-4.5/4.6 has the same inconsistency for names with leading/trailing spaces, tabs, or CRLF headers. Both streaming paths already normalize function names.

This PR consolidates the GLM-4.7/5 fix from #45962 with the independently reproduced GLM-4.5/4.6 fix.

**Confirmed root cause (parser-level reproduction):** Both non-streaming detectors pass the untrimmed function-name capture into argument-schema lookup and `parse_base_json`. The latter matches registered tool names exactly, so a name such as `get_weather\n` or `get_weather ` is treated as undefined and skipped. The tool-call span has already been consumed from visible content, which explains the empty response. Normalizing the captured identifier before these lookups resolves the reproduced failure while preserving argument-value whitespace.

## Modifications

- Strip surrounding whitespace from function names in both `Glm4MoeDetector` and `Glm47MoeDetector` before argument-schema lookup and tool validation.
- Add GLM4 regression coverage for name whitespace and actual/literal newline separators, asserting that argument-value whitespace is preserved.
- Include the GLM47 newline regression from #45962, which exercises non-streaming and several streaming chunk sizes.
- Use `CustomTestCase` for the two modified regression test classes.

## Attribution

The GLM-4.7/5 implementation and regression test are by [potoior](https://github.com/potoior), cherry-picked from commit [0fb629b6](https://github.com/potoior/sglang/commit/0fb629b6bb7c6e09452ce27acd46721d4ae6433b) in #45962. Original commit authorship is preserved, and the cherry-pick records its source. The other commits on that PR's branch were not imported.

The GLM-4.5/4.6 fix and its regression coverage are by goldenfox2025. The issue and its initial GLM47 reproduction were reported by [LucianMincu](https://github.com/LucianMincu).

## Accuracy Tests

Focused CPU validation, without model weights or a running server:

- GLM4 before/after: the new regression failed in all 10 whitespace subcases before the fix; all 12 subcases, including the unpadded-name controls, pass afterward.
- GLM47 before/after: the imported newline regression reproduces the missing-call failure without the GLM47 fix and passes with it.
- With both fixes: **41 test methods pass** across the GLM4, GLM47, Ling3, and GLM47 schema-type test classes. Two additional GLM47 tests requiring xgrammar were excluded because that dependency is unavailable locally.

The local isolation harness executes repository test-class bodies using the actual parser and protocol types. It bypasses the shared GPU/server test lifecycle and an unrelated response-schema conversion helper. These results do not establish that the normal pytest invocation or the entire unit-test module passes.

Standard CI verification in a configured SGLang environment:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_function_call_parser.py::TestGlm4MoeDetector \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_function_call_parser.py::TestGlm47MoeDetector \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_function_call_parser.py::TestLing3Detector \
  test/registered/unit/function_call/test_glm47_schema_types.py -q
```

Ruff 0.15.1 lint (`F401,F821,F823,UP037`), Ruff formatting, and `git diff --check` pass for all four changed files. GPU inference and full CI have not been run locally.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. The changes normalize extracted names without changing model computation or the streaming implementation.

## Checklist

- [x] Check formatting and relevant static checks on the changed files.
- [x] Include regression tests for both affected detectors.
- [x] Preserve authorship and credit the source contribution.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- Documentation: no public API or documented format changes.
- End-to-end accuracy/performance benchmarks: not run; this PR is limited to the demonstrated parser defects.

nodes.body: @Wangyuaneee Thanks for taking a look and reviewing the fix!

I reproduced this on `zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash` on one B200 with `--tp 1 --attention-backend triton --tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45`, default sampling, no seed. Requests were non-streaming, with `strict: true` tools and forced `tool_choice`.

On main at ba1ed00dfe, 14 of 720 requests returned `finish_reason: stop` with empty content and no `tool_calls`. Each raw output had a newline after the name. With this PR merged on that commit, none were dropped, and all 16 raw outputs with that newline returned the right call. Main dropped 13 of 240 with that newline in the prompt history and 1 of 480 without it.

I did not run GLM-4.5, GLM-4.6 or GLM-5.3 weights. This PR merges cleanly on main at 99fd01047d. It needs a review and the `run-ci` label. Full CI has not run.

@bvolpato Thanks for reproducing this on B200 and validating the fix!

I've updated the branch with the latest main. @JustinTong0323 could you review this and help enable CI when you have a chance?
